evals.name: input-first
evals.prompt: Map Authors, Add author, Name and Add into modeled actions. No row is selected.
evals.expected_output: Navigation to a screen-wide command before success navigation.
assertions: Separates opening the form from submission.
Binds Name as input to RegisterAuthor.
Returns to Authors on success only.

evals.name: availability
evals.prompt: Only CatalogEditors should be offered this action. What should we model and verify?
evals.expected_output: An audience gate separate from server authorization.
assertions: Declares the relevant audience or performer.
Does not treat hiding the action as server authorization.

evals.name: contract-gap
evals.prompt: The UI export contains a label, but no command identity. Is it sufficient?
assertions: Checks the resolved command and input contract.
Tracks source-only availability separately from exported bindings.
